records.name: Crush
records.one_liner: Go terminal coding product built on Fantasy, with SQLite sessions, MCP/tools/hooks, parallel delegates and a local HTTP server; harness implementation is internal.

dims.loop: Product coordinator constructs Fantasy agents and streams runs; callbacks handle tool state, steering/cancellation, persistence and continuation after compaction.
dims.providers: Fantasy adapters for Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock, Google, OpenAI, compatible endpoints, OpenRouter and Vercel; Catwalk supplies model metadata.
dims.tools: Coding/shell/process/fetch/search/LSP/question/todo tools and MCP; command output truncates with a spill file, while custom tool registration remains internal.
dims.context: AGENTS.md and skills roots, tool-result budgets and model-based session summarization; active context starts from the current summary pointer plus tail.
dims.state: SQLite WAL sessions and streaming message/usage saves support reopening and continuing work. No per-effect deterministic crash-replay contract established.
dims.safety: Permission allowlists, skip mode, session approvals and pre-tool hooks. No actual OS confinement implementation established by this review.
dims.extensibility: MCP, skills and PreToolUse hooks; hook responses can allow/deny/halt or rewrite input. No general public in-process harness plugin SDK established.
dims.multi_agent: Parallel Fantasy agent tool with parent-session/message/call linkage; no general workflow DAG or automatic child worktree allocation established.
dims.surfaces: TUI, headless run/continue and HTTP v1 service over local platform transports; Go internal package boundary prevents ordinary external imports of the product harness.
dims.observability: Session usage/cost, persistence and PostHog product events. OpenTelemetry export not established.

builds_on: Bubble Tea TUI, SQLite and MCP SDK
used_by: First-party Crush TUI and headless/server clients
key_insights: Fantasy is the lower-level reuse candidate; Crush itself adds product policy and keeps implementation in Go internal packages.
The license at this pin is FSL-1.1-MIT, not current MIT.
PreToolUse hooks and MCP provide useful extension without proving a general embedding SDK.

features_notes.plugins: Skills, MCP and hooks are verified; a general in-process plugin API is not.
features_notes.durable_resume: Saved session continuation; in-flight effect replay not established.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Unknown; approvals alone do not demonstrate confinement.
features_notes.worktrees: Existing-worktree recognition is not proof of child worktree creation.
features_notes.otel: Unknown; PostHog is a separate telemetry mechanism.

checked_claims: Fantasy dependency and product coordinator ownership
HTTP v1 server and run/continue clients
SQLite persistence, compaction and permission callbacks
limitations: Static source review; no build or runtime execution.
Unknown flags mean no implementation established, not a claim the entire repository lacks the feature.
Fantasy is inspected at the Crush consumer boundary, not independently audited as a complete runtime.
